title: Daily Tribute/Quotes
kind: 場所・ミッション・その他

lines: Transmissions upon getting the Daily Tribute.
- Darvo: "Hey friends, check this merch out!"
- Darvo: "Hey you. Yeah you. Friend, you like deals?"
- Darvo: "Because you're a friend, I'm going to offer you something special. Just remember, one per customer."
- Darvo: "Only one per Tenno. Don't get greedy."
- Darvo: "Hey Tenno, you ready for today's steal? Oh, I mean deal. Today's deal."
- Maroo: "Hey ya tin-suit. This your first time?"
- Maroo: "Ah, you look like a Tenno who knows the business."
- Maroo: "Oh me oh my would you look at these!"
- Maroo: "Lot of good stuff here, Tenno."
- Maroo: "Here we go, let's find some antiquities."
- Maroo: "Jackpot! That's what we're looking for."
- Ordis: "Thank you for returning to me Operator."
- Ordis: "Ordis is pleased to see you."
- Ordis: "Ordis has been—getting tired of waiting—waiting patiently for your return Operator!"
- Cephalon Simaris: "Tenno, you will make an excellent hunter."
- Cephalon Simaris: "May this aid you in the synthesis of many creatures."
- Cephalon Simaris: "I knew we had a shared passion, Hunter."
- Cephalon Simaris: "Hunter, you exceed expectations! You are far more exciting and complex than any specimen in my Sanctuary."
- Teshin: "Those who brave the thorn may eat the rare fruit."
- Teshin: "These offerings honor your suffering and practice."
- Teshin: "May this bring you honor, pupil."
- Teshin: "Use it well as you walk the harder path."
- Teshin: "New strength creates new weakness. Pupil, can you balance these opposing forces?"
- Teshin: "My pupil, the next summit awaits. Are you ready to make the climb?"
- Lotus: "Perseverance and loyalty are among your greatest assets, Tenno."
- Lotus: "You have fought hard and long Tenno. I want you to have this."
- Lotus: "Take this. As recognition for all you have done."
